channel.title: PointCast · Birthday
channel.description: Birthdays celebrated on PointCast — one block per person per year, one Noun per person forever. Indexed at /cake.

item.title: /sing — tap to sing happy birthday, polyphonic at scale
item.description: Six tap-zones, one per syllable. Tap through the song to sing it. Web Audio synthesized — no audio files. Single-player works alone; multiplayer additive when others tap on the same page (KV-backed soft chorus).

item.title: /cake v2 — registration, celebration, mint
item.description: Anyone can drop their birthday on PointCast now. Anyone can celebrate on a birthday block. The mint contract is filed and ready to originate. The Schelling point is built.

item.title: Happy birthday, Morgan
item.description: PointCast pauses today for a birthday in the house. Noun 888 is Morgan's, forever — and this is the inaugural entry in /cake, the place where birthdays are celebrated online.
